_comment: ops#250 — squasher fleet sweep registry (docs/plans/2026-08-31-ops250-squasher-fleet-sweep.md §2.3). Per-repo gate inputs migrated VERBATIM from the retired per-repo caller workflows (extracted from each repo's origin/main, 2026-08-31). This file is enumeration + gate inputs ONLY — it is NOT class policy: repoClassFor() in scripts/lib/automerge-classify.ts stays the source of truth for train-class/code-fix partitioning. `train: true` = the retired caller had a train_ready leg; the sweep then also enumerates open `queued` PRs for that repo (train invocations pass ONLY train_ready — required_checks/enabled_classes never apply in train mode). Absent optional fields fall back to the reusable gate's own defaults (enabled_classes is written explicitly because the sweep passes inputs positionally — an empty string would OVERRIDE the workflow_call default, not invoke it). 2026-09-06 (Kevin 'go'): code-fix enabled with safe_path_globs on bolt-wms (src/**), studiob (packages/api/src/**) and studiob-price-sync (src/** — extensions/** deliberately OUTSIDE: the checkout extension is customer-facing); asthetik-trade-theme and asthetik-portal stay docs-comment because a storefront/portal change without a QA receipt is Kevin's hand (#475); the code-fix line cap is 400 (automerge-classify.ts); required_checks name each repo's substantive CI job(s) (codex P2 on the door PR: an empty list leaves the named-checks leg fail-closed and the class inert).
